Class UserPasskeyResource

java.lang.Object
grafiosch.rest.UserPasskeyResource
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/user/passkey") public class UserPasskeyResource extends Object
The passkeys of the signed-in user. Adding one needs the password and, while an authenticator app is enabled, a code; renaming and deleting need no proof, since deleting only removes access. Adding and deleting end the other sessions of the user and return a replacement token in x-auth-token. Every access is restricted to the user's own passkeys.
